newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTOKUMPU TO BUILD COPPER PRODUCTS PLANT.
newsitem.headline: OUTOKUMPU TO BUILD COPPER PRODUCTS PLANT.

text.p: Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Monday it would build a copper products plant in Malaysia with an initial output capacity of 12,000 tonnes per year.
"The first step of the plant's construction will start immediately and this investment is around $25 million," Outokumpu said.
"Eventual total capacity will be over 20,000 tonnes per year," it said.
The product range of the plant in Johor Bahru would include drawn copper shapes, sections and strip, copper plating, anodes and tubes, Outokumpu said.
"The purpose of the investment is to better serve the globalising markets and customers," it said, adding it had been granted a manufacturing license with tax incentives by the Malaysian authorities.
